input_schema.description: A JSON Schema for a form to show before running it, when it takes input.

point.description:
The extension point it stands for (`payments.capture`), when it names one
instead of a URL: run it through that point's route (capturing the payment),
not the actions route.

navigate.description: A path within the app's page to go to.

refresh.description: Reload what the action was pressed on.

price.description: The base price, before markets and price lists.

selections.description:
One value per option, in the order of the product's `options`; empty for a
product without options.

sku.description: Unique across the store when set.

AddressRequest.description:
An address for the address book. Sending it again (PUT) replaces it whole,
including whether it is a default.

redacted.description:
Personal fields left out for this caller (design note 0029, AP10): an API key or
app without the matching `customer_data:*` scope. They are absent from the
object then, whatever the schema says. Never sent to staff or storefronts.

AdminExtensionsResponse.description: Every installed app's admin contributions to a target.

oneOf.description: Why it was cancelled; `null` if it wasn't.

cancelled_at.description: When it was cancelled, RFC 3339 in UTC; `null` if it wasn't.

custom_fields.description:
Its custom field values the caller may read (design note 0033); `PATCH
/admin/orders/{id}/custom-fields` writes them. A personal one is left out
without `customer_data:profile` and listed in `redacted` as
`custom_fields.<key>`.

payments.description:
Its payments, newest first (design note 0027): the method, status and
instructions of each.

unfulfilled.description:
Per line with anything left, in line order; empty once everything shipped or the
order was cancelled.

AdminOrderResponse.description:
An order as the admin sees it: with its cancellation and what's left to ship, by
location. A storefront's `OrderResponse` has neither: why staff cancelled an order
(`fraud`) is theirs to know.

AdminTarget.description:
An admin target (design note 0029, §5): a slot any admin may implement.

Known values: `apps.page`, `settings.app`, `order.details`, `order.payment`, `order.fulfillment`, `product.details`, `customer.details`, `payment`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

ApiKeyPage.description: A page of a list, newest first (design note 0012).

has_more.description: Whether there are more after these.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page. Opaque: don't parse it.

oneOf.description: A publishable key's sales channel; `null` for a secret key.

history.description: Its authorization requests, newest first (at most 50).

oneOf.description: `null` for an app made by hand.
`null` unless installed.

AppDetailResponse.description: An app with its grant, manifest, registrations and authorization history.

AppKind.description:
Which kind of app: an external service, or a spore built into the API.

Known values: `app`, `spore`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

items.description: By key.
By key.

callback_url.description: Where Hypha POSTs rate requests (signed with the app's secret).

key.description:
`app_<name>`: what options name it by, and the app (`/admin/apps/{key}`) whose
name, switch and secret apply.

services.description: Declared up front; empty means Hypha asks `<callback_url>/services`.

enabled.description: A disabled app gets no webhooks and quotes no rates.

oneOf.description: The approved scopes; `null` for an app made by hand, and after an uninstall.

id.description: What it acts as (`appid_…`): events it causes name it as their actor.

installed.description: Installed through OAuth, with a grant in force.

kind.description:
An external `app`, or a `spore` built into the API (design note 0030): staff
only enable or disable a spore.

missing.description:
A spore this API isn't built with any more (taken out of the deployment, design
note 0030, Q7): its app, settings and tables stay, and it does nothing until a
build has it again. Always `false` for an external app.

subscriptions.description: Event types it gets: exact (`order.placed`), a kind (`product.*`) or `*`.

uninstalled_at.description:
When it was uninstalled (it then only gets `app.uninstalled`); `DELETE` again
removes it.

oneOf.description: Where its events go; `null` when it takes none.

AppSecretResponse.description: An app with its signing secret: returned once, when created or rotated.

secret.description: Verify `Hypha-Signature` on webhooks and rate requests with it. Shown only now.

AssetKindDto.description:
`AssetKind` on the wire.

Known values: `image`, `video`, `file`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

AssetPage.description: A page of a list, newest first (design note 0012).

has_more.description: Whether there are more after these.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page. Opaque: don't parse it.

checksum.description: SHA-256 as hex, when the uploader declared it.

status.description: Only `ready` assets are listed and can be attached.

thumbnail_url.description:
Images only: a version at most 400 pixels wide when the media URLs can resize,
else the original.

url.description:
The file, once ready. A public file's URL never changes content; a private
file's is signed and works for `media.download_expires` (15 minutes by default).

AssetStatusDto.description:
`AssetStatus` on the wire.

Known values: `pending`, `ready`, `failed`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

AssetUsagePage.description: A page of a list, newest first (design note 0012).

has_more.description: Whether there are more after these.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page. Opaque: don't parse it.

role.description: How the owner uses it: for a product, `featured` (its first item) or `gallery`.

oneOf.description: `null` detaches the current price list.
`null` puts the products back on each country's default rate.

BasisDto.description: Known values: `flat`, `subtotal`, `weight`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

BlockExtension.description:
A declarative block: fetch its tree from
`GET /admin/app-extensions/blocks/{app}/{id}` with the target's context.

url.description: The app's own URL for it (Hypha fetches it; frontends use the blocks route).

BlockResponse.description:
A block's UI tree, checked against the block format v1
(`packages/app-blocks/schema/block.v1.json`).

tree.description:
`{version: 1, root}`: render it with your own components (`@hypha/app-blocks`
for React). Elements of types newer than v1 may appear: skip them.

notify.description: Email the buyer that the order is cancelled (`false` if absent).

CancelReasonDto.description:
`CancelReason` on the wire (design note 0018).

Known values: `customer`, `inventory`, `fraud`, `declined`, `staff`, `other`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

currency.description: The currency of every amount in the cart.

oneOf.description: Who to contact about the order; required at checkout.

fully_available.description: False when any line is unavailable; checkout should refuse such a cart.

market.description: Picked from the country when the cart was created; it sets the currency.

oneOf.description: The order this cart was checked out as; `null` while it can still change.

How the buyer chose to pay (`PUT …/payment-method`); checkout requires one when
there's something to pay.

redacted.description:
Personal fields left out for this caller (design note 0029, AP10): an API key or
app without the matching `customer_data:*` scope. They are absent from the
object then, whatever the schema says. Never sent to staff or storefronts.

oneOf.description: Where it ships: in the cart's country. Required at checkout when something ships.

shipping_groups.description:
The groups of lines that ship together, each needing a chosen option before
checkout; empty when nothing ships.

shipping_ready.description: Whether every group has an option priced now (checkout requires it).

shipping_total.description: The chosen shipping, priced now; zero until chosen. Part of `total`.

subtotal.description: Sum of the available lines, as priced. All totals count available lines only.

tax_total.description:
Tax on the available lines and on shipping: part of `subtotal` and
`shipping_total` if `taxes_included`, else on top.

taxes_included.description: Whether line prices include tax (set on the market).

CatalogProductPage.description: A page of a list, newest first (design note 0012).

has_more.description: Whether there are more after these.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page. Opaque: don't parse it.

CatalogProductResponse.description:
A product in a catalog. Catalogs store product IDs as given, so the product's fields
are `null` for an ID that names no product.

oneOf.description: An image asset that's uploaded and public; `null` clears it.

CategoryNode.description: A category in the admin's tree: what a list of categories shows, with its children.

custom_fields.description:
The custom field values `?custom_fields=` asked for (design note 0033); absent
without it.

CategoryProductPage.description: A page of a list, newest first (design note 0012).

has_more.description: Whether there are more after these.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page. Opaque: don't parse it.

CategoryProductResponse.description:
A product directly in a category. Product IDs are stored as given, so the product's
fields are `null` for one that names no product.

products.description: Product IDs aren't checked: one that names no product is stored and never shows.

CategoryRef.description: A category next to it in the tree: an ancestor or a child.

ancestors.description: Nearest first: its parent, its parent's parent, … (a breadcrumb, reversed).

created_at.description: When it was created, RFC 3339 in UTC.

custom_fields.description:
Its custom field values the caller may read (design note 0033); `PATCH
/admin/categories/{id}/custom-fields` writes them.

description.description: Sanitised HTML (scripts, styles and event attributes removed), safe to render.

oneOf.description: The image from the media library; `null` without one.

updated_at.description: When it last changed, RFC 3339 in UTC.

visible.description: `false` hides it, and everything below it, from the storefront.

items.description:
The top-level categories, each with its children, in order. A store has tens or
hundreds, so the whole tree comes in one response.

token.description: Send back to `POST /admin/auth/login/mfa` with a code.

ChannelKind.description:
What a channel is for. More kinds may come: show unknown ones as `custom`.

Known values: `online_store`, `agentic`, `custom`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

items.description: Oldest first. A store has a handful, so they come in one list.

products.description: Product IDs. They aren't checked: an unknown one is stored and never matches.

created_at.description: When it was created, RFC 3339 in UTC.

updated_at.description: When it last changed, RFC 3339 in UTC.

code.description: From the authenticator app, or (to disable or regenerate) a recovery code.

ConsentAnswer.description: Where to send the browser after an answer, or a private app's credentials.

oneOf.description:
A private app's tokens (it has no redirect to take a code), present only in the
answer to its approval: show them once, like an API key.

redirect_to.description:
The app's redirect URI with `code` and `state` (approved), or `error=access_denied`
and `state` (denied): navigate the browser there. `null` when a private app was
approved: show `credentials` instead.

ConsentApp.description: The app as its manifest describes it, for the consent page.

client_id.description: The manifest's URL: the app's client ID.

installed.description: Whether the app is installed (a grant in force): then this is a change of scopes.

privacy_url.description: The app's privacy policy: link it.

private.description:
A private app (its manifest uploaded to this store): approving answers with its
credentials instead of a redirect.

ConsentCustomField.description:
A custom field the app declares (design note 0033, §8), always in its own namespace
(`app_<name>.<key>`).

personal.description: The value is about a person: the app asks for `customer_data:profile` to see it.

ConsentRequestResponse.description: An authorization request, as the consent page shows it.

custom_fields.description:
The custom fields the app declares, against the definitions it has now: approving
creates `added`, updates `kept` and deletes `removed` with their values.

expires_at.description: The request can be answered until then (RFC 3339).

groups.description: The scopes that aren't personal data, by area.

personal_data.description:
The `customer_data:*` scopes asked for, with the manifest's reasons: list these
apart, so staff see exactly which personal data the app will see.

redirect_uri.description: Where the browser goes after the answer; empty for a private app.

scopes.description: Every scope asked for, in `Scope` order (personal-data ones included).

items.description: Sorted by code: the assigned ISO 3166-1 codes, so it comes in one response.

name.description:
The English name ("South Korea"). UIs show their own language's name
(`Intl.DisplayNames`) and fall back to this.

oneOf.description:
Required for a publishable key: the sales channel its storefront sells through
(`GET /admin/channels`). A secret key has none.

scopes.description: Required for a secret key; a publishable key always has the storefront scopes.

key.description: `app_<name>`: lowercase letters, digits and `_`, at most 64 characters.

byte_size.description:
Exactly the file's size: storage refuses another. Images up to 20 MB, videos up
to 1 GB, PDFs up to 100 MB.

checksum.description: SHA-256 as 64 hex characters: storage then refuses other contents.

filename.description: The file's name, kept for people; up to 255 characters.

description.description: HTML, sanitised when stored (at most 64 KiB).

handle.description: Lowercase letters, digits and single dashes; unique across categories.

oneOf.description: `null` or absent: a top-level category.

position.description: Among its siblings, from 0; absent or past the end: last.

visible.description: Whether the storefront shows it. Required: there's no default (CA10).

name.description: Up to 255 characters, unique ignoring case.

oneOf.description: Default: admin `read_write`, storefront `none`.

key.description: `[a-z0-9_]{2,64}`, starting with a letter; unique per owner type in `custom`.

lines.description: Each order line once; at most what it has left to ship.

location.description:
Where the units leave from. Another location than the one holding them is fine:
its stock goes down, and the reservation elsewhere is released.

notify.description: Email the buyer a shipping confirmation (`false` if absent).

continue_selling.description: Keep selling when stock runs out. Defaults to false.

tracked.description: Defaults to true: creating an item is how stock tracking starts.

markets.description: The markets whose buyers this location's stock is sold to.

priority.description: Lower goes first when several locations could fill a line. Defaults to 0.

channels.description: Sales channels it's offered in (absent or empty: every one); unchecked likewise.

instructions.description: Up to 2000 characters, shown after checkout; blank is none.

markets.description:
Markets it's offered in (absent or empty: every one). Not checked: an unknown
one never matches.

name.description: Up to 255 characters, e.g. "Cash on delivery".

position.description: Where shoppers see it; absent puts it after every method there is.

provider.description:
`manual`, or an app's key `app_<name>`: an installed, enabled app answering the
extension point `payments.start` (`payment_provider_unknown` otherwise).

settings.description:
The provider's settings, checked by it (`invalid_payment_settings`); `manual` and
apps take none (`{}`, the default).

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, each in no other zone.

token.description: The key itself, shown only in this response.

Currency.description: An ISO 4217 currency code. Funds, precious metals and test codes (XDR, XAU, XXX) aren't accepted.

items.description: Sorted by code. A fixed list of about 150, so it comes in one response.

minor_units.description:
Digits after the decimal point (0 for JPY, 2 for EUR, 3 for KWD). Amounts are
always integers in minor units: 1050 is 10.50 EUR but 1050 JPY.

name.description:
The English name ("Japanese Yen"). UIs show their own language's name
(`Intl.DisplayNames`) and fall back to this.

CustomFieldAccess.description: Who sees and writes a field's values (design note 0033, §5).

CustomFieldAdminAccess.description:
What staff may do with an app's or a spore's field; the merchant's own are always
`read_write`.

Known values: `read`, `read_write`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

CustomFieldCapabilities.description: What a field's values can be used for (§7).

filterable.description:
A filter on its owner's admin list (`field[custom.material]=wool`); at most 50
per owner type.

unique.description:
No two owners hold the same value (text ignoring case): `text`, `integer` and
`url` only. Filtering on it finds at most one owner.

CustomFieldChangesDto.description:
What approving does to the app's custom fields, compared with the definitions its
namespace holds now (everything is `added` on a first install).

added.description: Fields the app adds: list the owners they're on, and which are personal.

removed.description: Fields the app no longer declares: approving deletes them with their values.

retyped.description:
Fields whose type the manifest changes: such a manifest can't be approved
(`422 manifest_invalid`).

CustomFieldChoice.description:
A `choice` field's choice: the key is what's stored, filtered and faceted (it can't
change); the label is for people.

items.description:
By owner type, then position. A store has at most 128 per owner type and
namespace, so they come in one response.

field.description: `namespace.key`: what values, filters and events name it by.

managed_by.description:
The app or spore that declares it (`app_<name>`, `spore_<name>`); `null` for the
merchant's own. Those are read-only here (`409 custom_field_managed`).

personal.description: About a person: redacted without `customer_data:profile` (customers and orders).

position.description: On its owner type's form, from 0.

private.description: Only its app (and staff) read it.

CustomFieldStorefrontAccess.description:
Whether storefronts see the field (opt-in).

Known values: `none`, `read`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

CustomFieldValidations.description:
A definition's validations; which apply depends on its type (design note 0033, §3).
Absent ones don't apply.

min.description:
In the type's own terms: an integer, a decimal string, a date or date-time,
money's minor units, a measurement `{"value", "unit"}`.

pattern.description:
`text`: a regular expression the whole value matches (no look-around or
back-references).

unique_items.description: Lists: no item twice (text ignoring case).

CustomFieldsResponse.description: An owner's values as the caller sees them, with versions for `if_versions`.

custom_fields.description:
`{"custom.material": "wool", …}`: every value the caller may read, by the
definitions' order.

redacted.description:
Personal fields left out for this caller (`custom_fields.<key>`): an API key or
app without `customer_data:profile`. Never sent to staff.

created_at.description: When it was created, RFC 3339 in UTC.

custom_fields.description:
Its custom field values the caller may read, `{"custom.tier": "gold", …}`
(design note 0033); `PATCH /admin/customers/{id}/custom-fields` writes them.

orders.description: What the customer's orders add up to (design note 0032).

redacted.description:
Personal fields left out for this caller (design note 0029, AP10): an API key or
app without the matching `customer_data:*` scope (`custom_fields.<key>` for a
personal custom field, without `customer_data:profile`). They are absent from the
object then, whatever the schema says. Never sent to staff or storefronts.

updated_at.description: When it last changed, RFC 3339 in UTC.

CustomerSummaryPage.description: A page of a list, newest first (design note 0012).

has_more.description: Whether there are more after these.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page. Opaque: don't parse it.

CustomerSummaryResponse.description: A customer in a list: without the address book (design note 0024).

address_count.description: How many addresses the address book holds.

created_at.description: When the customer was created, RFC 3339 in UTC.

custom_fields.description:
The custom field values `?custom_fields=` asked for (design note 0033); absent
without it.

redacted.description:
Personal fields left out for this caller (design note 0029, AP10): an API key or
app without the matching `customer_data:*` scope. They are absent from the
object then, whatever the schema says. Never sent to staff or storefronts.

updated_at.description: When the customer last changed, RFC 3339 in UTC.

DeliveryPage.description: A page of a list, newest first (design note 0012).

has_more.description: Whether there are more after these.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page. Opaque: don't parse it.

DeliveryResponse.description: One event on its way to an app.

id.description: Sent as `Hypha-Delivery-Id`, the same on every attempt.

next_attempt_at.description: When it's tried next, while pending.

DeliveryStatus.description:
Where a delivery stands.

Known values: `pending`, `succeeded`, `failed`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

Email.description: An email address; stored trimmed and lowercased, so responses show it that way.

Error.description:
Every error body, for the OpenAPI documents (design note 0010, S9). `ApiError`
serializes as this shape.

code.description: Stable snake_case code: what clients match on.

details.description: Data a client acts on, for the codes that have any (see each operation).

id.description: Their prefixed ID; `null` for the system.

EventEnvelope.description:
An event as apps receive it (design note 0016, EV5), and as
`GET /admin/events/{id}` shows it.

data.description: The facts of the change; see the event catalog.

version.description: The payload's version: a reshaped payload is a new version of the same type.

Its version after the change, when it has one: deliveries can arrive out of
order, and a consumer drops an event older than one it applied (EV7).

ExtensionApp.description: An app that contributes, for labels.

ExtensionCallOutcome.description:
How an extension call ended.

Known values: `ok`, `failed`, `timeout`, `invalid`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

ExtensionCallPage.description: A page of a list, newest first (design note 0012).

has_more.description: Whether there are more after these.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page. Opaque: don't parse it.

ExtensionCallResponse.description: One call Hypha made to the app's extension point.

correlation.description: What the call was for: the cart, order or payment ID.

error.description: Why it wasn't `ok`: the app's own error `code` when it sent one.

status.description: The answer's HTTP status, when one came.

ExtensionContextDto.description:
The objects a block or action is used on (checked against its target: an order
block needs `order_id`, and takes no `product_id`).

point.description:
A point this Hypha calls apps through: `payments.start`, `payments.capture`,
`payments.void`, `payments.refund` or `search.query` (`unknown_extension_point`
otherwise). Shipping rates are registered as a shipping provider's
`callback_url`.

url.description:
Where Hypha POSTs the point's request, signed: `https://`, or `http://localhost`
for development.

key.description:
`option.<name>`, `vendor`, `product_type`, `tag`, or `field.<namespace>.<key>`:
a product or variant custom field that's `filterable`, shown to storefronts
(`access.storefront: read`) and of type `text`, `choice`, `boolean`, `integer`
or a list of those (`422 facet_field_not_allowed` otherwise).

label.description: Up to 255 characters; absent or `null` lets the storefront label it.

FinancialStatusDto.description:
`FinancialStatus` on the wire. A DTO of its own, so the domain enum carries no
serde and renaming a variant can't silently change the API.
Derived from the order's payments (design note 0027, PA7): manual payments use
`pending`, `paid` and `voided`; the rest come with providers that move money so.

Known values: `pending`, `authorized`, `partially_paid`, `paid`, `partially_refunded`, `refunded`, `voided`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

challenge.description: The challenge token from the first step.

code.description: A 6-digit code from the authenticator app, or a recovery code.

FixedPricePage.description: A page of a list, newest first (design note 0012).

has_more.description: Whether there are more after these.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page. Opaque: don't parse it.

variant_title.description: The variant's option values ("M / Blue"); `null` for a product without options.

oneOf.description:
The variant's product; `null` when the variant no longer exists (fixed prices
store variant IDs as given).

line.description: An order line of the order in the URL.

items.description: Newest first, cancelled ones too.

created_at.description: When it was recorded, RFC 3339 in UTC.

updated_at.description: When it last changed, RFC 3339 in UTC.

FulfillmentStateDto.description:
`FulfillmentState` on the wire.

Known values: `shipped`, `cancelled`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

FulfillmentStatusDto.description:
`FulfillmentStatus` on the wire.

Known values: `unfulfilled`, `partially_fulfilled`, `fulfilled`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

GrantHistoryEntry.description: One authorization request in an app's history.

oneOf.description: Who answered (an app answering for itself: no new scope, approved at once).

previous_scopes.description: The grant when it asked; `null` for a first install.

GrantResponse.description: The scopes staff approved for an app installed through OAuth (design note 0029).

scopes.description: What the app's tokens may do, at most.

InstalledManifestResponse.description: The manifest an app was installed from.

document.description: The manifest as checked, every URL absolute (`docs/apps/manifest.schema.json`).

url.description: Its URL: the app's OAuth client ID.

InventoryResponse.description:
A variant's stock. `id` is `null` when stock was never set up for the variant,
which means untracked (always sellable).

created_at.description: When the item was created, RFC 3339 in UTC; `null` for a variant without one.

updated_at.description: When the item last changed; `null` for a variant without one.

items.description: Oldest first.

token.description:
The `hypha_inv_…` token from the invite's link. In the body, not the URL, so it
stays out of access logs.

InviteLookupResponse.description:
What the invite page shows before anyone signs up: nothing more than the email's
recipient already knows.

email.description: Who the invite is for; the account will log in with it.

invited_by.description: The staff member who sent it, when there is one.

role.description: The name of the role it gives.

Language.description: A BCP 47 language tag: a language, then optionally a script, region and variants (`en`, `en-GB`, `sr-Latn`). Responses show it in canonical case.

available.description: `on_hand - reserved`; negative when more is reserved than is there.

reserved.description: Set aside for orders, not yet shipped.

available_quantity.description:
How many of the variant can be bought now, so a quantity input can stop there:
`null` when there's no limit (stock isn't tracked, or it sells past zero).

handle.description:
The product's handle, to link to its page; `null` when the product is gone or the
cart is checked out.

oneOf.description:
The variant's image, else the product's first media item; `null` without one,
once checked out, or where the deployment has no file storage.

product_title.description:
The product's title now; `null` only when the product or variant is gone, so an
unavailable line still says what it was.

variant_title.description: The variant's option values ("M / Blue"); `null` for a product without options.

oneOf.description: `null` when the cart's country has no tax rates.

add.description:

SporeSettingsResponse.description: A spore's settings, with the form to edit them.

schema.description:
The spore's JSON Schema for the form: scalar fields only (`string`, `integer`,
`number`, `boolean`, with `enum`, lengths and bounds); a secret one is marked
`"x-hypha-secret": true`.

settings.description:
The values as set. A secret field is never shown: it's `{"set": true}` once set,
`{"set": false}` before.

updated_at.description: When they were last saved; `null` before the first save.

password.description:
The current password: a stolen session alone can't put an authenticator on the
account.

oneOf.description: Where shoppers and agents can write to the store.

default_language.description:
The language the store's content (titles, descriptions, option labels) is written
in (design note 0021, SU5).

legal_name.description: The registered business name, for invoices and legal pages.

setup.description: How far the admin's setup guide got (design note 0024, AU11).

oneOf.description: Clients convert times with it; the API keeps every time in UTC.

items.description: Oldest first. A store has a handful, so they come in one list.

oneOf.description: The class whose rate applied; `null` for the country's default rate.

TaxRate.description: A tax rate in parts per million: 250000 is 25 %.

items.description: Oldest first, at most one per country, so they come in one list.

TemplatePart.description:
Which source of a template a problem is in; `layout` when rendering found it in the
shared frame.

Known values: `subject`, `html`, `text`, `layout`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

TemplateProblemResponse.description: What the template engine reported, as `template_invalid`'s `details` has it too.

sent_to.description: The calling staff member's address, the only one a test goes to.

amount.description: In minor units of the table's currency.

up_to.description: The tier applies while the basis is below this (exclusive); `null` on the last.

Timezone.description: An IANA time zone name, as `Intl.supportedValuesOf("timeZone")` lists them.

secret.description: Base32, for typing into the app.

TrackingDto.description: A tracking number, with the carrier and a URL to follow it when known.

UnfulfilledDto.description: Units of a line still to ship, and where they wait (design note 0018, FU4).

oneOf.description:
The location holding them for the line; `null` for units held nowhere (an
untracked item): any location.

UpdateAppProviderRequest.description: Callback, timeout, services (JSON Merge Patch; none take `null`).

UpdateAppRequest.description:
Name, switch, webhook and subscriptions (JSON Merge Patch: `webhook: null` removes
the webhook; the others take no `null`).

UpdateAssetRequest.description: A JSON Merge Patch of an asset's metadata: absent fields stay, `null` clears.

alt.description: Describes the image for screen readers and search engines; up to 255 characters.

title.description: The library's label; up to 255 characters.

UpdateCategoryRequest.description:
A JSON Merge Patch of a category: absent keeps, `null` clears (the description) or
moves to the top level (the parent).

oneOf.description:
Moves it under another category, or to the top level with `null`. Refused when it
would sit under itself or a descendant, or nest deeper than allowed.

position.description: Among its (new) siblings, from 0; moving without one puts it last.

UpdateChannelRequest.description: A JSON Merge Patch of a channel.

UpdateCustomFieldDefinitionRequest.description:
A JSON Merge Patch of a `custom` definition: absent keeps; `null` clears the
description. Owner type, key and type never change.

capabilities.description: Turning `unique` on is checked against the stored values, like validations.

validations.description:
Replaces them all. A change that tightens them (a lower `max`, fewer `choices`, a
`pattern`) is checked against the stored values first: `409
custom_field_values_invalid` names the owners to fix.

UpdateCustomerRequest.description:
JSON Merge Patch (see `patch`): only the fields sent change, `null` clears a name or
phone. The email can be changed but not cleared.

UpdateFulfillmentRequest.description: A JSON Merge Patch of a fulfilment: absent fields stay as they are.

notify.description: Email the buyer the new tracking, if it changed (`false` if absent).

tracking.description: Replaces every tracking number (at most 10; `[]` removes them).

UpdateInventoryItemRequest.description: Every field optional: only the ones sent change.

UpdateLocationRequest.description: Every field optional: only the ones sent change.

oneOf.description: Where it ships from; `null` removes it.

UpdateMeRequest.description: JSON Merge Patch on the caller's own profile: only the fields sent change.

UpdateNotificationSettingsRequest.description:
JSON Merge Patch: absent keeps, `null` clears (`accent` and `staff_recipients` take
no `null`).

oneOf.description:
An image from the media library: ready and public (`asset_not_ready`,
`asset_not_public`, `asset_kind_not_allowed`). It can't be deleted while it's the
logo.

order_url.description:
An http(s) URL with `{order}`, and optionally `{token}`, e.g.
`https://shop.example.com/order/{order}?token={token}`.

staff_recipients.description: At most 10 addresses; the whole list.

UpdateOptionRequest.description: An option's fields (JSON Merge Patch; `estimate` and `tax_class` take `null`).

UpdatePaymentMethodRequest.description: A JSON Merge Patch of a payment method. The provider can't change.

channels.description: Replaces the list; empty for every channel.

markets.description: Replaces the list; empty for every market.

position.description: Where shoppers see it: reordering is setting positions.

settings.description: Replaces the provider's settings, checked by it.

UpdateProductRequest.description: Title and handle (JSON Merge Patch; neither can be `null`).

description.description:
HTML, up to 64 KiB; it's sanitised (scripts, styles and event attributes are
removed), and the response has what was kept. `null` clears it.

handle.description: Changing it changes the product's storefront URLs; old ones aren't redirected.

tags.description:
Replaces every tag. Up to 250; blanks are dropped and duplicates (ignoring case)
keep their first spelling.

UpdateRoleRequest.description: JSON Merge Patch: only the fields sent change.

UpdateSearchSettingsRequest.description: A JSON Merge Patch of the settings.

facets.description: At most 20, unique; empty for the defaults.

search_app.description:
An installed, enabled app answering `search.query` (`app_<name>`;
`search_app_unavailable` otherwise); `null` for the built-in engine.

split_by.description:
At most 3 option names, unique ignoring case. Changing them rebuilds every
search document in the background.

UpdateStoreRequest.description: A JSON Merge Patch of the store: absent fields stay as they are.

default_language.description: A BCP 47 tag such as `en` or `sr-Latn`.

description.description: Plain text, at most 500 characters, trimmed; `null` or blank clears it.

oneOf.description: Replaced whole; `null` clears it.

legal_name.description: At most 255 characters, trimmed; `null` or blank clears it.

setup_finished.description:
`true` marks the guide done (the first time sets `finished_at`); `false` shows it
again from its step.

setup_step.description:
The setup guide step the merchant is on: 1 to 40 lowercase letters, digits, `-`
or `_`, named by the admin (design note 0024, AU11). `null` clears it.

timezone.description: An IANA name such as `Europe/Belgrade`; `null` clears it.

UpdateUserRequest.description: JSON Merge Patch: only the fields sent change.

UpdateVariantRequest.description: A variant's SKU, price and option values (JSON Merge Patch).

selections.description: One value per option, in option order; another variant can't have them.

UpdateZoneRequest.description: Name and countries (JSON Merge Patch; neither can be `null`).

expires_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC: the URL stops working then.

kind.description: `product`, or a spore's own kind of owner.

items.description:

value.description:

first written.

items.description: Most held first.

custom_fields.description:

0033); `PATCH /admin/variants/{id}/custom-fields` writes them.

oneOf.description: The item of the product's `media` this variant shows (an image), if any.

price.description: The base price, before markets and price lists.

requires_shipping.description: `false` for what is never shipped (downloads, gift cards).

selections.description: One value per option, in the order of `options`.

title.description: Its option values ("M / Blue"); `null` for a product without options.

weight_grams.description: `null` when not entered; carriers and weight-tiered rates need it.
